Rashi on Arakhin 16a:10:1.english: And when he was strong, his heart was lifted up, etc. - [The verse] is speaking of Uzziah.

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:12:1.english: [That which] he designated [for] his house - His utensils of use, which he did not lend to others.

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:13:1.english: Why was it juxtaposed, etc. - In the portion of Ve'atah Tetzaveh, the matter of the Milu'im was juxtaposed to the priestly vestments.

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:13:2.english: And they dipped the tunic in blood - It was a hint to them that the dipping for the atonement of bloodshed is effected through a tunic.

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:15:1.hebrew: אין אפוד ותרפים - בזמן שאין אפוד, הוי עון תרפים:
Rashi on Arakhin 16a:15:1.english: Without ephod or teraphim - At a time when there is no ephod, there is the iniquity of teraphim.

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:15:2.hebrew: שבקול - פעמוני המעיל נשמעין. על מעשה קול — לשון הרע, ואת אמרת נגעים אתו עליה:
Rashi on Arakhin 16a:15:2.english: [An item] that [produces] sound - The bells of the robe are heard. [And it atones] for an act of sound — malicious speech; and [yet] you said afflictions come upon him?

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:17:1.hebrew: אהנו מעשיו - שנתקוטטו על ידו. ואי קשיא: אמאי לא מותיב ליה משפיכות דמים וגילוי עריות, דקאמר לעיל נגעים באין עליהם, והכא תניא דבגדי כהונה מכפרין? תריץ: דהא דתני בגדי כהונה מכפרין — לאו עליה דידיה, אלא על האחרים שעל ידו נענשין. דבשפיכות דמים כתיב (במדבר ל״ה:ל״ג) כי הדם הוא יחניף וגו', ובגילוי עריות כתיב (ויקרא י״ח:כ״ה) ותטמא הארץ ואפקוד עונה עליה; אבל לשון הרע, לא אשכחן דמיענשי ביה אחריני:
Rashi on Arakhin 16a:17:1.english: His actions were effective - That [people] quarreled on his account. And if it is difficult: Why did [the Gemara] not object to him from bloodshed and illicit sexual relations, as it said above that plagues [of tzara'at] come upon them, whereas here it is taught that the priestly garments atone? Resolve [it]: That which it taught, that the priestly garments atone, is not for [the sinner] himself, but rather for the others who are punished on his account. For regarding bloodshed it is written (Numbers 35:33): “For blood pollutes [the land]…” etc.; and regarding illicit sexual relations it is written (Leviticus 18:25): “And the land was defiled, therefore I visited its iniquity upon it”; but [as for] slander, we have not found that others are punished on its account.

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:19:1.hebrew: שבחשאי - קטורת נעשית בהיכל בחשאי, כדתניא בפרק הוציאו לו במסכת יומא (דף מד.): פורשין מבין האולם ולמזבח בשעת הקטרה. לשון הרע בחשאי הוא:
Rashi on Arakhin 16a:19:1.english: That [is done] in secret - The incense is offered in the Sanctuary in secret, as it is taught in the chapter 'Hotzi'u Lo' in Tractate Yoma (44a): [People] withdraw from between the Porch and the Altar at the time of the burning of the incense. Malicious speech is [done] in secret.

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:1:1.hebrew: דמיתאמרא באפי תלתא - שהבעלים אמרוה בפני ג', המגלה אותה אינו לשון הרע, שזה גילה תחלה דעתו שאם מגלה אותו אינו חושש, דמידע ידע דסופה להגלות, דחברך חברא אית ליה, וזה מגלה לחבירו וזה לחבירו עד שיודע:
Rashi on Arakhin 16a:1:1.english: That is said in the presence of three - Where the owner said it in the presence of three [people], one who reveals it is not [guilty of] malicious speech, for this [owner] initially revealed his mind that if [someone] reveals it, he is not concerned, as he well knew that it was destined to be revealed, for "your friend has a friend," and this one reveals [it] to his friend and this one to his friend, until it becomes known.

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:20:1.hebrew: קשיא שפיכות דמים וכו' - דקאמרינן לעיל: בגדי כהונה מכפרין על אחרים, וקא חזינן דעגלה ערופה מכפרת על אחרים — דעל ההורג אינה מכפרת, דקיימא לן בסוטה (דף מז:), שאם נתערפה העגלה ואח"כ נמצא ההורג, מנין שהוא נהרג? תלמוד לומר: "ולארץ לא יכופר" וגו':
Rashi on Arakhin 16a:20:1.english: [The statement concerning] bloodshed is difficult, etc. - For we said above [that] the priestly garments atone for others, and we see that the heifer whose neck is broken atones for others — for it does not atone for the murderer [himself], as we maintain in Sotah (47b), that if the heifer's neck was broken and afterward the murderer was found, from where [is it derived] that he is executed? The verse states: "And for the land there shall be no expiation..." etc.

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:20:2.english: [The statement concerning] malicious speech is difficult - [Because of that] which [was stated] above, which taught that the priestly garments atone.

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:21:1.english: [Where] it is not known who killed him - The heifer [whose neck is broken] atones.

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:22:1.hebrew: בר קטלא הוא - וכל כמה דלא מיקטל, לא מיכפרי אחריני, דכתיב (במדבר ל״ה:ל״ג) ולארץ לא יכופר וגו':
Rashi on Arakhin 16a:22:1.english: He is subject to execution - And as long as he is not executed, others are not atoned for, as it is written (Numbers 35:33): “And no expiation can be made for the land, etc.”

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:23:1.english: In private - For incense atones for an act [done] in secret.

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:2:1.hebrew: מברך רעהו בקול גדול וגו' קללה תחשב לו - אותה ברכה קללה היא לו — לחבירו:
Rashi on Arakhin 16a:2:1.english: He who blesses his friend with a loud voice, etc., it shall be counted a curse to him - That blessing is a curse to him — [that is,] to his friend.

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:2:2.hebrew: ושמעין אינשי - אלמים שהוא עשיר, ואזלי ואנסי ליה לממוניה. ל"א: אנסי ליה — שמתאכסנין אצלו אורחין, עד שמכלין ממונו:
Rashi on Arakhin 16a:2:2.english: And people hear - Violent men [hear] that he is wealthy, and they go and extort his money. Another explanation: "They afflict him" — that guests lodge with him until they consume his money.

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:3:1.hebrew: בא לידי רעתו - שכשהוא מספר בטובתו יותר מדאי, הוא עצמו אומר: "חוץ ממדה רעה זו שבו"; או אחרים שומעין שזה משבחו, ואומרים: "הלא מדת כך וכך בידו":
Rashi on Arakhin 16a:3:1.english: [He] comes to his detriment - For when he speaks in his praise excessively, he himself says: "Except for this bad trait that is in him"; or others hear that this one is praising him, and say: "Does he not possess such-and-such a [bad] trait?"

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:5:1.hebrew: צרות העין - שצרה עינו באחרים, ואינו מהנה שכיניו מכליו ע"י שאלה:
Rashi on Arakhin 16a:5:1.english: Stinginess - That his eye is begrudging toward others, and he does not let his neighbors benefit from his utensils through borrowing.

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:6:1.english: Him will I destroy - And we established above that this refers to leprous marks.

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:7:1.english: Let there not be cut off from the house of Joab - Because he killed Abner.

Rashi on Arakhin 16a:8:1.english: Swear - Swear that Elisha sent you, and take two talents.

Tosafot on Arakhin 16a:10:1.hebrew: ובחזקתו גבה לבו וגו' - גבי עוזיה כתוב. בדברי הימים כתיב (ד"ה א ה): "ויוחנן הוליד [את] עזריה (הכהן) [הוא] אשר כיהן (בתוך) בבית אשר בנה (המלך) שלמה [בירושלים]". וצ"ע: למה כתיב עליו "אשר כיהן" יותר מן האחרים, שהוא מונה שם כל כהנים גדולים אשר שמשו בבית ראשון, והרי מונה לפניו כמה כהנים — ולמה כתיב "אשר כיהן" גבי (עוזיה) [עזרי'] יותר מן האחרים? וי"ל: לפי שהוא הכניס עצמו להתווכח על הכהונה כשבא עוזיה, יותר מן האחרים:
Tosafot on Arakhin 16a:10:1.english: "And when he became strong, his heart was lifted up, etc." - It is written regarding Uzziah. In Chronicles it is written (I Chronicles 5:36): "And Yochanan begot Azariah; [he is] the one who served as priest in the House that Solomon built [in Jerusalem]." And it requires investigation: Why is it written about him, "who served as priest," more than the others? For it enumerates there all the High Priests who served in the First Temple, and behold, it enumerates several priests before him — so why is it written "who served as priest" regarding [Azariah] more than the others? And one can say: Because he put himself forward to dispute over the priesthood when Uzziah came, more than the others.

Tosafot on Arakhin 16a:14:1.hebrew: אבנט מכפר על הרהור הלב - אהיכא דאיתא. ואבנט הוא כמו חגור של שש, ארוכה מאד. ואיתא נמי במדרש, שהיה הכהן מקיפו סביביו ב' פעמים, כנגד לב של אדם:
Tosafot on Arakhin 16a:14:1.english: "The belt atones for the thought of the heart" - [The Gemara explains: It atones for] where it is situated. And an avnet is like a sash of fine linen, [which was] very long; and it is also stated in the Midrash that the priest would wind it around himself twice, opposite a person's heart.

Tosafot on Arakhin 16a:17:1.hebrew: הא דאהנו מעשיו - פירש רש"י: שנתקוטטו על ידו. ואי קשיא: אמאי לא מותיב ליה משפיכות דמים וגילוי עריות, דקאמר לעיל נגעים באין עליהם, והכא תניא דבגדי כהונה מכפרים? תריץ: דהא דתני בגדי כהונה מכפרי' — לאו עליה דידיה, אלא על אחרים, דע"י שפיכות דמים נענשים העולם, דכתיב (במדבר ל״ה:ל״ג): "כי הדם הוא יחניף", ובגילוי עריות כתיב: "ותטמא הארץ ואפקוד עונה עליה"; אבל לשון הרע לא אשכחן דאיענשי ביה אחריני — לשון רש"י. ולא נהירא, שהרי במסכת שבועות (דף לט.) אומר דעל כל העבירות אחרים נענשים עליהם אם יש בידם למחות, ואי אין בידם למחות — אפי' ג"ע וש"ד נמי לא! ואור"י: דמשפיכות דמים לא קשיא מידי, לפי שיש עליה מיתת ב"ד, ובגדי כהונ' מכפרין על המיתה, אבל נגעים מיהא באין עליו. ועוד יש מפרש, דהאי דמשני הש"ס "הא דאהנו מעשיו, הא דלא אהנו מעשיו" קאי נמי אשפיכות דמים וגילוי עריות. וה"פ: "אהנו מעשיו" — היינו כשהרג ממש, ועליו אין בגדי כהונה מכפרים, אלא נגעים באין עליו; "לא אהנו מעשיו" — כגון שלא הרג ממש, אלא שהלבין פני חבירו ברבים, דקיימא לן (ב"מ דף נח:): "כל המלבין פני חבירו ברבים כאילו שופך דמים", ועל זה בגדי כהונה מכפרים; וכן גילוי עריות: ממש — אהנו מעשיו, ולא אהנו מעשיו — זהו כי הא דאמרי' (שבת דף נה:): "מתוך ששהו קיניהן מעלה עליהם כאילו שכבום":
Tosafot on Arakhin 16a:17:1.english: "This [is a case] where his actions were effective" - Rashi explained: That they quarreled on his account. And if [one asks] a difficulty: Why didn't [the Gemara] object against him from bloodshed and forbidden sexual relations, as [the Gemara] said above that afflictions come upon them, whereas here it is taught that the priestly vestments atone [for them]? Resolve [it]: That which was taught, that the priestly vestments atone, is not for him [the sinner] himself, but rather for others; for through bloodshed the [people of the] world are punished, as it is written: "For blood pollutes [the land]" (Numbers 35:33), and regarding forbidden sexual relations it is written: "And the land became defiled, and I visited its iniquity upon it" (Leviticus 18:25); but regarding evil speech, we do not find that others are punished through it — [this is the] phrasing of Rashi. And [this] is not clear, for in Tractate Shevuot (39a) it says that for all transgressions, others are punished on their account if it is in their power to protest, and if it is not in their power to protest, even [for] forbidden sexual relations and bloodshed [others are] not [punished] either! And the Ri says: That from bloodshed there is no difficulty at all, because for it there is the court[-imposed] death penalty, and the priestly vestments atone for the death [penalty], but afflictions nevertheless come upon him. And furthermore, there is [one who] explains that this [resolution] which the Gemara answers — "This is where his actions were effective, this is where his actions were not effective" — also applies to bloodshed and forbidden sexual relations. And this is its explanation: "His actions were effective" — that is when he actually killed, and for him the priestly vestments do not atone; rather, afflictions come upon him; "His actions were not effective" — such as where he did not actually kill, but rather publicly shamed his fellow, as we maintain (Bava Metzia 58b): "Whoever publicly shames his fellow, it is as though he sheds blood," and for this the priestly vestments atone; and similarly [regarding] forbidden sexual relations: Actual [immorality is where] "his actions were effective"; and "his actions were not effective" — this is like that which we say (Shabbat 55b): "Because they delayed their bird-offerings, [Scripture] considers it as though they had lain with them."

Tosafot on Arakhin 16a:1:1.hebrew: כל מילתא דמיתאמרא באפי תלתא לית בה משום לישנא בישא - פירוש: כגון כה"ג דנורא בי פלוני, דאיכא למישמע דלא אמרה משום לישנא בישא. אבל אם הוא אמר דבר קנטור על חבירו, אפילו היה אומרה בפניו — אית ביה משום לישנא בישא:
Tosafot on Arakhin 16a:1:1.english: "Any matter that is said in the presence of three [people] does not have [the status of] malicious speech" - Explanation: For example, in a case such as that of "fire at so-and-so's [house]," where it can be understood that he did not say it as malicious speech. But if he said a derogatory remark about his fellow, even if he were to say it in his presence — it has [the status of] malicious speech.
